coach.name: Rob Senderoff
coach.notes: Entered 2026-27 at 312-186 (.627) overall, all at Kent State, and 163-105 (.608) in MAC play, per the Wikipedia 2026-27 MAC season page (citing Sports Reference). Winningest coach in program history. Contract extension through the 2028-29 season was announced April 5, 2023 by AD Randale Richmond (added three years to his 2021 deal; News 5 Cleveland). MAC Coach of the Year 2021-22. Kent State went 24-10 (14-4 MAC) in 2025-26 and played in the NIT for a second straight year, then lost its entire starting lineup and top five scorers (sMACk Talk, Kent Stater). Senderoff's streak of home-opener wins from his first season through 2024 ended in 2025 with a loss to Troy; he won the 2026 home opener 102-50 over Roberts Wesleyan (Mid-Major Basketball).

previews.title: MAC Announces 2026-27 Men's Basketball Preseason Poll, All-MAC Teams
previews.projected_finish: 4th of 12 (108 points, 1 first-place vote); 1 of 12 votes to win the MAC Tournament
previews.summary: The MAC coaches' poll placed Kent State fourth behind Miami (130 points, 9 first-place votes), Toledo (117, 2) and Akron (110), and ahead of Ohio (82). Kent State received one first-place vote and one vote to win the conference tournament. Senior guard Chansey Willis Jr. was named Preseason All-MAC First Team. No other Kent State player was on either preseason team.

previews.title: 2026-27 Mid-American Men's Basketball Overview
previews.author: Kaily "KG" Godek and Foster Roesti
previews.projected_finish: Lists preseason poll position of 4th; no independent prediction
previews.summary: Notes Kent State went 24-10 (14-4) in 2025-26 under 16th-year coach Rob Senderoff but lost its top five scorers to the portal or graduation: Delrecco Gillespie (Houston), Cian Medley (East Carolina), Jahari Williamson (Pepperdine), and graduates Morgan Safford and Rob Whaley Jr. Sophomore guard Quinn Woidke is the highest-scoring returner. Transfers Godslove Nwabude (Eastern Michigan), Chansey Willis Jr. (Minnesota) and Cameron Williams (Portland) are listed as key additions. Non-conference includes at UNC Wilmington (Nov. 11), Wyoming at the Sunshine Slam (Nov. 24) and the Sun Bowl Invitational (Dec. 20-21). The writers argue that if Kent State loses no more than two non-conference games it could be a problem for the rest of the league.

previews.title: 2026-27 MAC Men's Basketball Preview
previews.author: Sam Federman
previews.summary: Federman says he is most excited by Kent State's ceiling. The backcourt should score heavily, led by Minnesota transfer Chansey Willis Jr. (a former Western Michigan standout) and freshman Dhani Miller. Fordham transfer Christian Henry, if eligible, adds MAC experience and playmaking. The frontcourt is weaker without Delrecco Gillespie, but Cameron Williams and Latif Diouf are upside options; the writer says the frontcourt typically determines Senderoff's floor.

storylines.headline: Complete rebuild: all five starters and top five scorers gone
storylines.detail: Kent State lost its entire starting lineup from the 24-10 NIT team: Delrecco Gillespie (Houston), Cian Medley (East Carolina), Jahari Williamson (Pepperdine), plus graduates Morgan Safford and Rob Whaley Jr. Rayvon Griffith and Deandre Jones also entered the portal. Senderoff rebuilt through the portal (Nwabude, Diouf, Williams, Willis Jr., Dorian Jones, Christian Henry) and a signing class headed by Dhani Miller.

storylines.headline: Chansey Willis Jr. returns to the MAC as the preseason first-teamer
storylines.detail: Detroit native and former Western Michigan star (16.8 PPG, 5.8 APG in 2024-25) spent an injury-shortened 2025-26 at Minnesota (7 games) before transferring to Kent State; named Preseason All-MAC First Team.

storylines.headline: Quinn Woidke moves off the ball as the lone returning scorer
storylines.detail: Woidke (9.0 PPG, 40.4% 3PT as a freshman) told Field of 68 he was returning; in the Nov 6 home opener he scored 13 with four threes and described 'kind of a more off the ball role this year.'

storylines.headline: Christian Henry eligibility question
storylines.detail: Mid-Major Madness (Oct 28) described Fordham transfer Christian Henry as a contributor 'if eligible'; no resolution found in coverage read this session.

storylines.headline: Jamal Sumlin back in the MAC Center
storylines.detail: Redshirt senior guard Jamal Sumlin ('Wopp'), who originally transferred to Kent State in April 2024 and last played at the MAC Center in 2024-25, returned to the court in the Nov 6 home opener as a defensive tone-setter (7 pts, 3 ast).

storylines.headline: 0-1 start at Louisiana Tech, then a 52-point home-opener rout
storylines.detail: Kent State dropped the MAC-Sun Belt Challenge opener 85-75 at Louisiana Tech on Nov 2, then beat Roberts Wesleyan 102-50 on Nov 6. Next: at UNC Wilmington Nov 11.

players_in_coverage.name: Chansey Willis Jr.
players_in_coverage.previous_school: Minnesota (also Western Michigan, Henry Ford College, Saginaw Valley State)
players_in_coverage.notes: Preseason All-MAC First Team. Detroit native, Michigan HS Player of the Year. At WMU 2024-25: 16.8 PPG, 5.8 APG, 4.3 RPG. At Minnesota 2025-26: 6.3 PPG, 3.0 RPG, 3.3 APG, 41.0% FG, 26.7 MPG, limited to 7 games by injury.

players_in_coverage.name: Quinn Woidke
players_in_coverage.notes: Lakewood, Ohio. 2025-26: 34 games, 9.0 PPG, 43.2% FG, 40.4% 3PT, MAC All-Freshman Team. Highest-scoring returner. 13 points with four 3s vs Roberts Wesleyan (Nov 6); playing more off the ball; praised for vocal leadership.

players_in_coverage.name: Godslove Nwabude
players_in_coverage.notes: 2025-26 at EMU: 5.4 PPG, 5.5 RPG, 1.6 BPG. Senderoff after Nov 6: 'He's got the ability to be on the all-defensive team in our league.' Official signing release dated Apr 13, 2026 (not readable).

players_in_coverage.name: Cameron Williams
players_in_coverage.previous_school: Portland (previously Trinity Valley CC, Moberly CC)
players_in_coverage.notes: 2025-26 at Portland: started 28 of 31 games, 10.6 PPG, 4.7 RPG, season high 25; scored 20 vs Kent State on Dec 14, 2025. Won a JUCO title at Trinity Valley in 2024-25. Third portal addition of the spring.

recent_news.headline: New faces lead Kent State to 102-50 win over Roberts Wesleyan in home opener
recent_news.detail: Kent State led 16-2 early and had four double-figure scorers: Latif Diouf 15, Quinn Woidke 13 (four 3s), Jamal Sumlin 7 pts/3 ast; Godslove Nwabude and Landon Vanderwarker praised for defense.
